ErrorAlerts._comment: Admin error alerting. 'Email' = who receives alerts (overridden by the error.notify_email setting; else the first super-admin). 'Smtp' = an OPTIONAL dedicated always-on SMTP (e.g. SMTP2GO) so error alerts send INDEPENDENTLY of the app's member-email system (works before email go-live, never redirected by email.override_recipient). Set Host/Username/Password in appsettings.Production.json. Leave Host empty to fall back to the normal app email queue.

Cloudflare._comment: Set Enabled=true ONLY when traffic is proxied through Cloudflare. The real client IP is then read from the CF-Connecting-IP header, but ONLY for connections from the ranges below (otherwise the header is spoofable and per-IP rate limiting can be bypassed). Ranges: https://www.cloudflare.com/ips/ (verified 2026-06).
